name: exploded-v60-pareto-26.10-preview-s1-r5
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of a V60 pour-over dripper on its glass server, as an SVG. Use the cone dripper with a paper filter rather than a metal mesh filter.

source.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="800" height="1100" viewBox="0 0 800 1100">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="ceram" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#BFC5CB"/>
      <stop offset="0.28" stop-color="#F3F5F7"/>
      <stop offset="0.62" stop-color="#E6E9EC"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#8F959C"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="paperG" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#E9D8B8"/>
      <stop offset="0.3" stop-color="#FBF3DF"/>
      <stop offset="0.68" stop-color="#F2E6C8"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#D3BE95"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="glassG" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#A9C3C9" stop-opacity="0.55"/>
      <stop offset="0.24" stop-color="#EAF4F5" stop-opacity="0.55"/>
      <stop offset="0.52" stop-color="#C3D8DC" stop-opacity="0.4"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#7FA0A8" stop-opacity="0.6"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="coffeeG" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#8A5A32"/>
      <stop offset="0.35" stop-color="#A9713F"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#6E4626"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="woodG" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#9C6F41"/>
      <stop offset="0.3" stop-color="#C89B66"/>
      <stop offset="0.7" stop-color="#B5884F"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#82593B"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="rimG" cx="0.5" cy="0.42" r="0.65">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#F8FAFB"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#C2C9CF"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="holeG" cx="0.5" cy="0.42" r="0.65">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#F7F9FA"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#CBD2D8"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <marker id="arw" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7.5" markerHeight="7.5" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#7B8794"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- background -->
  <rect width="800" height="1100" fill="#F7F5F0"/>
  <ellipse cx="400" cy="1052" rx="330" ry="20" fill="#000" opacity="0.05"/>
  <ellipse cx="400" cy="377" rx="110" ry="12" fill="#000" opacity="0.05"/>
  <ellipse cx="400" cy="684" rx="170" ry="14" fill="#000" opacity="0.05"/>

  <!-- ===================== titles ===================== -->
  <text x="400" y="42" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif" font-size="25" letter-spacing="7" fill="#3A3F45">EXPLODED ASSEMBLY</text>
  <text x="400" y="66" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif" font-size="14" letter-spacing="4.5" fill="#9AA0A6">V60 POUR-OVER · 02 DRIPPER</text>
  <text x="400" y="84" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif" font-size="11.5" letter-spacing="3" fill="#B8BDC2">CONE DRIPPER · PAPER FILTER · GLASS SERVER</text>

  <!-- ===================== parts list ===================== -->
  <g font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif">
    <rect x="530" y="104" width="230" height="112" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E2DDD3"/>
    <text x="546" y="127" font-size="10.5" letter-spacing="2.5" fill="#9AA0A6">PARTS LIST</text>
    <g font-size="12.5" fill="#42474D">
      <circle cx="555" cy="145" r="3.2" fill="#E4D2AA"/><text x="567" y="149.5">Paper filter (02)</text>
      <circle cx="555" cy="170" r="3.2" fill="#5C6771"/><text x="567" y="174.5">Dripper cone (ceramic)</text>
      <circle cx="555" cy="195" r="3.2" fill="#A9C6CB"/><text x="567" y="199.5">Glass server 600 ml</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- ===================== stage labels ===================== -->
  <g font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" letter-spacing="2.5" fill="#98A0A8" text-anchor="middle">
    <text x="400" y="125">01 — PAPER FILTER (02)</text>
    <text x="400" y="424">02 — DRIPPER CONE</text>
    <text x="400" y="1020">03 — GLASS SERVER</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ===================== stage 01 : paper filter ===================== -->
  <g>
    <!-- Thin, open paper cone; sealed seam runs to its point. -->
    <path d="M282 220 L400 368 L518 220 Q400 272 282 220Z" fill="url(#paperG)" stroke="#BDA77F" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <ellipse cx="400" cy="220" rx="118" ry="29" fill="#E2CDA7" stroke="#BDA77F" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <path d="M284 220 Q400 174 516 220 Q400 206 284 220Z" fill="#F5EAD3"/>
    <path d="M282 220 A118 29 0 0 0 518 220" fill="none" stroke="#FFF8E9" stroke-width="3"/>
    <path d="M487 241 L400 368 L475 245" fill="#D9C295" stroke="#BDA77F" stroke-width="1"/>
    <path d="M478 246 L403 361" fill="none" stroke="#AE956C" stroke-dasharray="2 3"/>
  </g>

  <!-- leader 01 -->
  <path d="M204 269 H274 L318 267" fill="none" stroke="#7B8794" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <text x="286" y="254" text-anchor="end" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#5C6771">paper filter (02)</text>
  <path d="M560 352 H508 L443 305" fill="none" stroke="#7B8794" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <text x="566" y="356" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#5C6771">folded seam</text>

  <!-- ===================== stage 02 : dripper cone ===================== -->
  <g>
    <!-- Integral support saucer rests on the server mouth. -->
    <path d="M268 642 A132 26 0 0 1 532 642 L532 651 A132 26 0 0 1 268 651Z" fill="url(#ceram)" stroke="#82888F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="400" cy="642" rx="132" ry="26" fill="url(#rimG)" stroke="#82888F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- Closed ceramic loop, attached at both ends. -->
    <path d="M558 486 C646 463 643 590 496 561" fill="none" stroke="#82888F" stroke-width="18"/>
    <path d="M558 486 C646 463 643 590 496 561" fill="none" stroke="#E5E8EB" stroke-width="13"/>
    <!-- body cone -->
    <path d="M224 474 L 376 640 A 24 10 0 0 0 424 640 L 576 474 Z" fill="url(#ceram)" stroke="#82888F" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <!-- top opening wall (visible through rim opening) -->
    <path d="M224 474 A 176 40 0 0 1 576 474 L 560 474 A 160 34 0 0 0 240 474 Z" fill="#A9AFB6" opacity="0.6"/>
    <!-- flange rim -->
    <path d="M224 474 A 176 40 0 0 0 576 474 A 176 40 0 0 0 224 474 Z" fill="url(#rimG)" stroke="#8A9097" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="400" cy="474" rx="150" ry="33" fill="none" stroke="#AEB5BB" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- Open mouth with raised spiral ribs on the interior. -->
    <ellipse cx="400" cy="474" rx="161" ry="33" fill="#BAC3CA" stroke="#8D99A2"/>
    <g fill="none" stroke="#E9EDF0" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round">
      <path d="M251 464 Q268 486 365 491"/>
      <path d="M280 452 Q290 477 382 490"/>
      <path d="M325 445 Q319 466 396 489"/>
      <path d="M379 442 Q354 463 408 488"/>
      <path d="M436 443 Q395 464 418 489"/>
      <path d="M491 449 Q448 469 427 492"/>
      <path d="M539 460 Q500 484 440 495"/>
    </g>
    <ellipse cx="400" cy="495" rx="20" ry="5" fill="#697782"/>
    <path d="M239 474 A161 33 0 0 0 561 474" fill="none" stroke="#F7F9FA" stroke-width="4"/>
    <g fill="none" stroke="#AFB8C0" stroke-width="2">
      <path d="M284 535 Q325 598 384 637"/>
      <path d="M319 533 Q337 595 393 639"/>
      <path d="M374 541 Q382 599 404 638"/>
      <path d="M433 535 Q427 597 415 637"/>
      <path d="M492 516 Q468 587 424 635"/>
    </g>
    <!-- exit hole -->
    <ellipse cx="400" cy="639.5" rx="24" ry="9.5" fill="url(#holeG)" stroke="#9AA1A8" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <path d="M400 631 A 24 9.5 0 0 0 424 639.5 A 24 9.5 0 0 0 400 648 A 24 9.5 0 0 0 376 639.5 A 24 9.5 0 0 0 400 631 Z" fill="#F2F4F6"/>
  </g>

  <!-- leader 02 -->
  <path d="M204 612 H260 L322 558" fill="none" stroke="#7B8794" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <text x="266" y="604" text-anchor="end" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#5C6771">60° inner wall</text>
  <path d="M640 453 H590 L491 462" fill="none" stroke="#7B8794" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <text x="646" y="457" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#5C6771">spiral ribs</text>

  <!-- ===================== stage 03 : glass server ===================== -->
  <g>
    <!-- Glass loop joins the neck and shoulder. -->
    <path d="M508 826 C608 804 624 941 534 931" fill="none" stroke="#7FA0A8" stroke-width="16"/>
    <path d="M508 826 C608 804 624 941 534 931" fill="none" stroke="#D8E7E9" stroke-width="10"/>
    <!-- body glass -->
    <path d="M278 804 Q302 849 286 872 C255 914 251 966 291 984 Q400 1010 509 984 C549 966 545 914 514 872 Q498 849 522 804Z" fill="url(#glassG)" stroke="#7FA0A8" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <!-- coffee -->
    <path d="M276 925 C270 951 277 972 299 979 Q400 1000 501 979 C523 972 530 951 524 925Z" fill="url(#coffeeG)" opacity="0.8"/>
    <ellipse cx="400" cy="925" rx="124" ry="20" fill="#B77E45" opacity="0.85"/>
    <!-- Open rim includes a small pouring lip on the left. -->
    <path d="M278 802 L250 786 L286 791 C330 772 480 774 513 794 C562 828 350 851 278 810Z" fill="#EAF4F5" fill-opacity="0.6" stroke="#7FA0A8" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <path d="M289 805 C325 832 482 831 512 805" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3"/>
    <path d="M292 851 Q400 877 508 851" fill="none" stroke="#8EAFB6" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.5"/>
    <!-- glass highlights -->
    <g stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none" opacity="0.7">
      <path d="M310 880 C 306 908, 310 942, 318 968" stroke-width="3"/>
      <path d="M330 878 C 327 904, 330 940, 337 958" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    </g>

    <!-- ml scale -->
    <g font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" fill="#536D75" stroke="#536D75" stroke-width="1">
      <path d="M442 875 H470 M450 891 H470 M442 907 H470"/>
      <text x="478" y="879" stroke="none">600 ml</text>
      <text x="478" y="911" stroke="none">400</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- leader 03 -->
  <path d="M216 948 H244 L280 906" fill="none" stroke="#7B8794" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <text x="210" y="952" text-anchor="end" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#5C6771">heatproof glass</text>

  <!-- ===================== assembly axis & callout arrows ===================== -->
  <line x1="400" y1="378" x2="400" y2="404" stroke="#7B8794" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-dasharray="5 4" marker-end="url(#arw)"/>
  <text x="422" y="396" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#7B8794">fits inside cone</text>
  <line x1="400" y1="685" x2="400" y2="770" stroke="#7B8794" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-dasharray="5 4" marker-end="url(#arw)"/>
  <text x="416" y="723" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#7B8794">base rests on server rim</text>
</svg>
